_doc: STORY SCENES for The Squeeze (Acts I-V). A scene binds a background image, a music track, and an entry dialogue node. Chapter/act/milestone fields feed the spoken Quest Recap and the debug chapter-warp menu.

scenes.name: The Backroom Trench
scenes.ambientDescription: A dead building at 3:47 in the morning: hydraulic hiss at the bay, the ballast hum of the fluorescents, and forty-eight feet of freight still on the trailer.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You clocked in at a Wally's World overnight unload, learned the freight line, met the crew, and survived your first wall of boxes.
scenes.defaultObjective: Learn the floor, meet the crew, brew the coffee, and run the 4 AM unload.

scenes.name: The Sales Floor
scenes.ambientDescription: A hundred thousand square feet of concrete and shelving under a vaulted ceiling: the store wakes, the floor crews fan out, and someone has to be in charge of the freight lanes.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You were promoted to Freight Supervisor, led the overnight crews, fixed the process, and held the floor through a front-end storm.
scenes.defaultObjective: Lead the crew, fix the process, and stand your ground on the floor.

scenes.name: The Front End
scenes.chapterTitle: Chapter 3: The Rot and the Offer
scenes.ambientDescription: The registers at the edge of the building, where the machine meets the public: the layoffs flow through here, and every exit is a door somebody was walked through.
scenes.milestoneTitle: Chapter 3: The Rot and the Offer
scenes.milestoneSummary: You saw the machine up close at the front end, made a private vow, and Jodie offered you an assistant-manager slot in Colorado.
scenes.defaultObjective: Hear the offer, see the rot, and decide whether to take the door out.

scenes.name: The Manager's Office
scenes.ambientDescription: The manager's office at the end of the hall: a cheap desk, a wall of laminated posters, and a computer that has already sent the email.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You learned Mattie-T's email was already sent — a quiet 'not ready' note that steered your slot to Lamar — disagreed with him respectfully, survived the office, and walked out to a truck pointed at Colorado, excited and still unaware how deep it ran.
scenes.defaultObjective: Face what Mattie-T built, survive the office, and choose your way out.

scenes.name: The Highway Oasis
scenes.ambientDescription: A tiny dot on the map flooded by semi-trucks, travelers with blown transmissions, and local ranchers. The service shop smells of fresh motor oil, burning rubber, and winter cold off the high plains.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You took the Shop Manager slot at the highway oasis, met Miss Trudy, and found a rhythm of competence in the bays — enough to run the shop at perfect ten-point-oh for a year.
scenes.defaultObjective: Own the bays, build the crew, and earn the best year the store has ever seen.

scenes.name: The Fall of Miss Trudy
scenes.chapterTitle: Chapter 6: The Fall of Miss Trudy
scenes.ambientDescription: The store floor tightens as corporate quietly hands Miss Trudy her 'early retirement' and Jury takes the office — the loose, functional calm condensing into a rigid, paranoid hierarchy.
scenes.milestoneTitle: Chapter 6: The Fall of Miss Trudy
scenes.milestoneSummary: Corporate tore out the store's heart, Jury tightened the grip, and you learned to shield your crew from a watchful eye that never blinks.
scenes.defaultObjective: Keep your people safe under a store manager who only cares that nothing bounces upward.

scenes.name: The Brick Wall
scenes.ambientDescription: Adriana's application, a flat denial, and the grievance grinding for a week before it comes back with the machine's favorite stamp: Unsubstantiated.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Adriana was denied the Shop Manager role because 'they wanted a man for the job.' You filed the first grievance. The machine stamped it Unsubstantiated and closed the file.
scenes.defaultObjective: Run the grievance to the area level and watch the machine tell the truth to no one.

scenes.name: The Christmas Party
scenes.ambientDescription: A rented community hall under fluorescent glare, bad catering, and a store manager with casual malice. The second grievance is signing itself in your pocket.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Jury degraded you in front of witnesses at the Christmas party, you filed the second grievance, and the machine returned exactly the same stamp: Unsubstantiated. The lesson stuck for good.
scenes.defaultObjective: Endure the final gaslight and learn the retail machine's one foundational truth.

scenes.name: The Body Keeps the Score
scenes.chapterTitle: Chapter 9: The Body Keeps the Score
scenes.ambientDescription: A burning nerve pain flaring across your forehead — Shingles Outbreak Number One — and a box truck pointed east, packed, leaving Lamar in the mirror.
scenes.milestoneTitle: Chapter 9: The Body Keeps the Score
scenes.milestoneSummary: Your body kept the score, you and Adriana chose a fresh start you paid for out of pocket, and you left Lamar behind — scarred, woke, and pointed east.
scenes.defaultObjective: Endure the first outbreak, choose your exit, and put the small-town rot in the rearview.

scenes.name: The State Line
scenes.ambientDescription: A rented house in the Georgia pines, a hundred-and-twelve-mile drive across the state line every morning, and a service shop in South Carolina that has been left to run on its own for years.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You crossed the state line into a neglected service shop, learned the true state of the bays, met a crew of seasoned techs and green apprentices — and smelled what years of nobody running the line had left behind.
scenes.defaultObjective: Learn the bays, meet the crew, and see whether the borderlands can be fixed.

scenes.name: The Gated Hierarchy
scenes.ambientDescription: The quarterly leadership tour sweeps the building: only the Store Manager walks with the visitors, the junior salaried managers are locked out on the floor, and the edict rolls down before the cars leave the lot.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You watched a leadership tour decide the shop's future from behind a glass door, learned the edicts that get sold out from under the people who run the building, and held the bays through the first impossible number.
scenes.defaultObjective: Survive the walkthrough, decode the edict, and hold the floor when the impossible number lands.

scenes.name: The Paralysis of Kindness
scenes.ambientDescription: Store Manager Azalia — your boss — is genuinely wonderful to every face in the building, and utterly unable to let one consequence stick. Every write-up her shop manager draws, she kindly unmakes. The kindness absorbs accountability like a sponge, and the problems stay exactly where they were.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You learned the store's terrible secret: a boss who loves every associate and unmakes every consequence her shop manager draws, leaving the conscientious to carry the building on their spines.
scenes.defaultObjective: Observe the paradox, keep holding the line anyway, and watch the costs of a boss who unmakes every consequence.

scenes.name: The Safety Breach
scenes.ambientDescription: Corners get cut under the turn-time clocks, a wheel comes loose in the back lot, and the store starts pre-fitting a fall guy who happens to be the manager who refused to sign. The only lever that can move the machine runs straight past the store.
scenes.milestoneSummary: A near-miss the store tried to bury, a refusal to sign off on dangerous work, and the secret protocol from Colorado — running the grievance straight to regional for the first small, functional win of your career.
scenes.defaultObjective: Refuse to sign, document the near-miss, and make the one lever that still works actually move.

scenes.name: The Second Scar
scenes.chapterTitle: Chapter 14: The Body Keeps the Score
scenes.ambientDescription: The second shingles outbreak flares across your forehead — one per state, one store per price paid. The truck is packed for Pueblo, the porch light goes dark, and Azalia's kindness follows you to the door, weightless and unaccountable to the end.
scenes.milestoneTitle: Chapter 14: The Body Keeps the Score
scenes.milestoneLocation: The Road Out of the Borderlands
scenes.milestoneSummary: Outbreak Number Two on the forehead, a cold farewell from the kindest manager you'll ever meet, and a truck pointed west toward Pueblo with a second scar as proof of the price.
scenes.defaultObjective: Endure the second outbreak, take the goodbye that never landed, and point the truck west.

scenes.name: The One-Man Close
scenes.ambientDescription: The Pueblo store at dusk: queues stacking at the registers, the service desk blinking, and one salaried manager closing forty thousand square feet alone, every night, for a year.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You took a stocking slot that turned out to be the store's only closing manager — no hourly supervisors, no backup — and held the queues, the seizures, the shift-change gangs, and the lonely midnight close alone for a year.
scenes.defaultObjective: Learn the close, meet the crew, and hold the building alone until sunrise.

scenes.name: The Overhaul Offer
scenes.ambientDescription: Year two: the bomb threat that empties the building, the man who lit himself on fire in the lot, a claim blizzard with your own name on a file — and the backroom table where the machine asks the closer to remake the store.
scenes.milestoneSummary: The madness of year two: a bomb threat, a self-ignition in the parking lot, every associate claiming discrimination on everyone — you included — and the regional offer you accept: lead the freight-to-floor overhaul. All this and the store inside had no supervisors at all.
scenes.defaultObjective: Armor the crew, survive the incidents, add your own name to the claims pile, and take the overhaul.

scenes.name: Number One in the Nation
scenes.chapterTitle: Chapter 17: Number One in the Nation
scenes.ambientDescription: The freight-to-floor overhaul: Stocking 2 rebuilt into a pure unload line, Stocking 1 into the bin-and-topstock army — and the board that climbs to Number One in the Nation under a backroom fluorescent.
scenes.milestoneTitle: Chapter 17: Number One in the Nation
scenes.milestoneSummary: You rebuilt the unload and the bins into a single machine, empowered the hourly crews — and took the store to Number One in the Nation, proof that the system works when leadership equips its people.
scenes.defaultObjective: Rebuild the unload, build the bin army, and take the store to the top of the country.

scenes.name: The Education of Richard
scenes.ambientDescription: A Regional Compliance Aspirant who cannot read a stocking report: Richard, gunning for Area Manager, taught one honest hour at a time by the closing manager nobody staffed.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You trained the clueless compliance climber, survived the compliance visit he led, and watched him take the Area Manager slot wearing your words — the delicious hypocrisy of the ladder, in full.
scenes.defaultObjective: Teach Richard enough to survive, keep the shine on the store, and watch the climber climb.

scenes.name: The Paradox of Jay-Dau
scenes.ambientDescription: The store manager who is your friend off the clock and pure hell on it — Jay-Dau — flanked by Store Leads Amandy's chaos and Steffie's two faces, in the office where trust goes to die.
scenes.milestoneSummary: The paradox of Pueblo's leadership: a friend who throws you to save his standing, a hostile store lead and a two-faced one — until the tyrant Amandy is promoted away and starts emailing you to save her.
scenes.defaultObjective: Keep the friend, decode the two faces, survive the clock, and teach the tyrant who tormented you.

scenes.name: The Graveyard
scenes.ambientDescription: Past midnight the store belongs to another species: thirteen overnight managers churned through the office in a single year — numbered like freight, broken and discarded — and the position is still open.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You watched Jay-Dau burn through thirteen overnight managers in one year and numbered them like freight — and then, knowing exactly what the overnight machine does, you took the job yourself.
scenes.defaultObjective: Learn the thirteen exits, protect the night crew, and feel the grinder before you step into it.

scenes.name: The Fatal Step
scenes.ambientDescription: Two months of the overnight grind, the third shingles outbreak screaming across the forehead, and the Jacksonville offer — with a relocation contract folded into the pocket like a bar tab the machine intends to collect.
scenes.milestoneSummary: The overnight grind broke the body, Outbreak Number Three hit with a vengeance, and the machine made its move: St. Augustine, Florida, under a relocation contract — the collar, accepted on paper, at the end of the longest act.
scenes.defaultObjective: Survive the grind, endure the third outbreak, weigh the trap with Adriana, and take the fatal step.

scenes.name: The Asphalt Gauntlet
scenes.ambientDescription: Interstate 95 between Jacksonville and St. Augustine at night: brake lights and construction walls, a commute that is a psychological torture test in its own right — one hour on a good night, three on a bad one, the collar of the relocation contract locked around the drive.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You moved to Jacksonville and inherited a commute that runs one to three hours each way into the dark — held in place by a relocation contract that would sink you if you walked. The road south is the first enemy of the act.
scenes.defaultObjective: Learn the road, read the collar, ride the gauntlet, and see the store that talks like sunshine.

scenes.name: The Honeymoon
scenes.ambientDescription: The St. Augustine Megamart overnight floor in its golden months: freight that moves like a river, metrics that stay green, and a store manager who can't praise you enough — while the biggest man in the building watches in polite, terrifying silence.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Sriniviii treats you like gold for three months; the overnight manager curse seems broken; metrics run green. The machine is only ever this nice right before it turns. Then you take your very first vacation.
scenes.defaultObjective: Meet the golden management, win the crew's trust, hold the meters — and take the vacation that ends the sunshine.

scenes.name: The Flip
scenes.ambientDescription: The store manager's office after the first vacation: the friendliness gone, replaced by a cold predatory stare, and every morning the ritual — after a full night shift, the verdict: It is not good enough. Goalposts on wheels.
scenes.milestoneSummary: One week off and the squeeze arrives: the warmth gone, every morning a ritual interrogation over a floor that was already perfect, and Ohmar — the region's enforcer — turning up the heat.
scenes.defaultObjective: Map the moving goalposts, face the terror of the office, and survive the beatdowns.

scenes.name: The Hostage Hours
scenes.ambientDescription: The backroom of the ownerless building at the end of a shift that never ends: three to four extra hours on microscopic tasks no one will ever check, the clock at the end of an eighteen-to-twenty-hour day, and the exit door that sometimes looks like the only argument left.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Upper management locks you in for three to four hours every night on meaningless tasks; the days stretch to eighteen or twenty hours; one night the exit door and the drive home stop looking like the same thing. The porch light brings you back.
scenes.defaultObjective: Endure the ownerless building, call home in the dark, and hold the crew that keeps you human.

scenes.name: The Sanctuary
scenes.ambientDescription: The overnight floor at three in the morning, where the associates are the only pure thing left in the building: clear expectations, no administrative ambushes, proper tools, and a manager who stands between them and the vultures when the sun comes up.
scenes.milestoneSummary: While management treats people like biological trash, the overnight crew is the opposite: honest, warm, and worth every ounce of shield you have left. You absorb the blows so they don't have to — until the body starts keeping score.
scenes.defaultObjective: Hear their stories, raise the shield, and hold the creed — before the fourth outbreak lands.

scenes.name: The 3 AM
scenes.ambientDescription: The cavernous backroom on mandatory medical leave at three in the morning: shingles across the forehead, the relocation debt humming in the rafters, and the darkest arithmetic of the whole memoir — encountered every night for two and a half weeks, and refused every single night.
scenes.milestoneSummary: The fourth shingles outbreak forces medical leave, and the commute-and-crucible finally pushes the mind to its edge. Night after night the alternative comes fully formed — and night after night Adriana's face refuses it. The epiphany: the corporation, the metrics, the contract are not worth dying for. The answer is to walk out. You step down, refuse the collar, and take the last drive north.
scenes.defaultObjective: Survive the fourth outbreak, refuse the 3 AM, make the radical choice, and get the hell out of St. Augustine.

scenes.name: The Crash
scenes.ambientDescription: The fluorescent hum of the main store floor in daylight — stripped of the protective isolation of overnights. Harsh, relentless, and entirely indifferent.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You stepped down from salaried management and absorbed a brutal $24,000 pay cut. The relief and the depression arrived on the same day.
scenes.defaultObjective: Survive the crash back to hourly and find a reason to keep showing up.

scenes.name: Timmy's Store
scenes.ambientDescription: A Florida megamart with a store manager who still knows every associate by name. A rare, specific silence: the sound of a building that hasn't been broken yet.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Under Timmy, the building felt manageable again — and then the machine promoted him out and sent Abdoolie in his place.
scenes.defaultObjective: Hold onto the peace while it lasts and brace for what replaces it.

scenes.name: Abdoolie's Store
scenes.ambientDescription: The same building under a different gravity. The store hasn't changed — the air has. The associates move slightly faster and look slightly sideways.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Abdoolie's cadence pulled every nerve back to St. Augustine. You named the difference and held the line.
scenes.defaultObjective: Survive the PTSD trigger and keep your feet on the right floor.

scenes.name: The Front-End Grind
scenes.ambientDescription: The registers and the service desk — where the public meets the machine and the machine meets you. Entitled, abusive, endless.
scenes.milestoneSummary: The daily customer grind and the phantom manager's blind threat drove the final decision: down again, all the way to the bays.
scenes.defaultObjective: Weather the front end and make the call.

scenes.name: The Shop Tech Pit
scenes.ambientDescription: Six bays, the smell of motor oil and burnt rubber, the rhythmic thunder of impact wrenches. The only part of the building the machine forgot to surveil.
scenes.milestoneSummary: Down in the bays with Tani and Cap'n H, you found the rarest thing the machine accidentally produces: genuine, competent, protective leadership.
scenes.defaultObjective: Settle into the pit and let Tani and Cap'n H show you what good looks like.

scenes.name: The Balance Sheet
scenes.ambientDescription: The shop bay at the end of the memoir: motor oil, sunrise light through the bay door, and the complete, verified stillness of a person who refused to be destroyed.
scenes.milestoneSummary: The machine broke the career. It tried to break the mind. It nearly took the life. But the soul walked out intact.
scenes.defaultObjective: Stand at the end and add up what actually survived.
